zoe_onboard: Heads-up — onboarding for NorthSky (org=northsky-prod) stalled. iOS app init spawns lots of background workers and we're seeing a tight 429 cluster against preflight during app cold-starts.

lina_cs: ack. App version / SDK? Are these happening for many users or just our QA canary?

zoe_onboard: app=NorthSky-iOS v2.7.1, sdk=ios@0.9.8, happening across multiple devices during staged rollout (we reproduce locally with simulator farm). Pattern: on cold start each JVM/swift process creates 6 token fetches in parallel for different features. First 1-2 succeed, rest hit 429s.

nate_eng: this is typical burst/fanout. Quick questions: are they using ephemeral keys per feature or a shared ephemeral per app-process? Also any CI warmups that could align?

zoe_onboard: they request ephemeral per feature (analytics, chat, embed) — so 3 separate preflight calls almost at the same time. No CI warmup, but the simulator farm launches 50 sim instances concurrently.

nate_eng: ok. Two-pronged plan: client changes + short infra assist. Client: gate parallel token fetches with a singleflight/mutex per process so only one preflight runs and result is shared. Add jittered retry/backoff and honor Retry-After. Also reduce initial parallelism to 1-2.

nate_eng: pseudo Swift singleflight sketch:

```
let tokenLock = NSLock()
var cachedToken: String?
func preflightOnce() async throws -> String {
  tokenLock.lock()
  if let t = cachedToken { tokenLock.unlock(); return t }
  tokenLock.unlock()
  // perform preflight, cache result
}
```

lina_cs: For onboarding steps we should ask them to increase their local process cache TTL to 60s so restarts don't immediately re-preflight. Also ask them to stagger simulator starts by 200-500ms.

morgan_infra: On infra side we can temporarily raise the preflight burst allowance for org=northsky-prod for a 3h window. I can do 3h if that's helpful.

zoe_onboard: That would be great. If we can get +3x burst for 3h starting ~now we'll coordinate staggered restarts.

morgan_infra: I'll schedule window: 2026-04-05T17:03:00Z -> 2026-04-05T20:03:00Z, change id nsq-20260405-02. Pushing now.

ops_bot: quota-adjustment applied change_id=nsq-20260405-02 org=northsky-prod window_start=2026-04-05T17:03:00Z window_end=2026-04-05T20:03:00Z actor=morgan_infra :white_check_mark:

zoe_onboard: thanks. We'll implement singleflight and TTL change in the next deploy and stagger sims by 300ms.

nate_eng: Two additional tips: 1) Respect `X-Rate-Limit-Remaining` and `X-Rate-Limit-Reset` headers in responses to back off gracefully. 2) If they must prewarm multiple features, do them sequentially with a tiny async gap (50-200ms) to avoid synchronized bursts.

lina_cs: Also capture `sdk.preflight.latency` by device+process to see if backoffs correlate with 429 spikes. If they still fail after the quota window, we'll request request-trace ids and a short HAR capture.

zoe_onboard: Will do. I'll send a quick snippet to their eng lead with the singleflight example and the recommended TTL change.

morgan_infra: change id confirmed in logs. Let me know when they kick the fleet and I'll monitor the preflight error rate.

zoe_onboard: kicking staggered sims in ~10m. Will report back within the window. Thanks all :pray:
